title: Pacioli publishes double-entry bookkeeping
summary: Pacioli's Summa de arithmetica, printed in Venice, included one of the first published descriptions of double-entry bookkeeping, the method Venetian merchants used.
why: Double-entry accounting still underpins business everywhere.

notes.problem: 'The first published work... on the continent' is stronger than the source body ('one of the first published descriptions'); 'on the continent' is unclear.
